quarterly_data.quarter: Nanya Technology press release: Nanya Technology to Build 3D Wafer Packaging and Testing (10-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Nanya received approval from Taiwan's National Science and Technology Council (NSTC) to establish a 3D wafer packaging and testing fab in Pingtung Science Park. The company says the new fab will incorporate advanced 3D IC technologies, including through-silicon via (TSV) and wafer stacking, to develop integrated wafer-level packaging and testing capabilities for high-performance and high-bandwidth memory solutions driven by the rapid expansion of AI applications.
